config.title: PicList
config.serverKey.description: Server key of PicList, or of PicList-Core started with `-k`, sent as the `key` query parameter. Only needed when the server runs on another machine.
config.picbed.description: Image host to upload to instead of PicList's default, such as `github` or `aws-s3`. Leave empty to use the default.
config.configName.description: Name of the image host configuration to use with `#piclist.picbed#`. Leave empty to use the default configuration.
config.encodeUrl.description: Encode the copied URL before output. Default: `false`.
config.remoteServerMode.description: Enable uploads through a remote server. Default: `false`.
config.enablePasteUpload.description: Upload images pasted into the editor, such as screenshots, and insert the result. When disabled, you can still upload a single paste by running `editor.action.pasteAs` with the argument `{ "kind": "piclist.upload" }`, for example from a keybinding. Default: `false`.
config.skipRemoteImages.description: When uploading all or selected images, skip images that already have an `http(s)` URL and upload only local images. Default: `false`.
